items.author: cryptogoos
items.context: cryptogoos: dice que $BTC nunca cerró 6 semanas rojas seguidas durante el último mercado alcista y afirma que Bitcoin está «MASIVAMENTE infravalorado» (con gráfico).
items.suggested_text: Six red weeks in a row is rare, but "it never happened before" isn't a floor. Undervalued compared to what? I'd rather check where price sits vs the long-term power law trend than lean on streak stats. How I read it: https://x.com/forecastquant/status/2118779927340470279

items.author: Strike
items.context: Strike: cita la noticia de que Binance cerrará cuentas en la UE el 31-dic y cobrará una comisión mensual sobre lo que quede; ofrece a europeos un nuevo hogar para su bitcoin: licencia MiCA, solo bitcoin y retiros gratis a autocustodia.
items.suggested_text: Free withdrawals to self-custody is the part that matters here. The next question is where the keys get generated: a device that never touches the internet removes a whole class of risk. I wrote a book on building your own air-gapped setup, free on Kindle until Wednesday (today): https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HQ5NS31N?dplnkId=c09ef739-11f3-4c76-8c62-92ce160a3341&nodl=1

items.author: cryptorover
items.context: cryptorover: cita a Trump diciendo que el gobierno de EE. UU. vendió decenas de miles de $BTC que hoy valdrían miles de millones y que desde ahora seguirá la regla de todo bitcoiner: «nunca vendas tu bitcoin» (video).
items.suggested_text: "Never sell" is easy to say and hard to do in a drawdown. Spot, no leverage and keys you actually control are what make it possible to hold through one.
